# SMP: Students Manager Project Software

Description
-

This Software to Manager Students and Teachers and their classes with their courses and their marks and their grades and their absences and their attendances
-

Install
-

- `SMP` is a `Python` based project.

- ### Linux

  - `sudo apt-get install python3`
  - `sudo apt-get install python3-pip`
  - `git clone https://github.com/Yazan-Dev9/Students_Manager-SMP`
  - `cd SMP/`
  - `python3 setup.py`
